sources.text: Synthetic PrismBridge experiment D42: replaying the same frame sequence ID twice caused duplicate notifications. De-duplicating by sequence ID removed duplicate notifications without suppressing distinct frames that had identical pixels. This is a reported experiment result, not a new live test.
Synthetic PrismBridge recorded configuration: config/streaming.yaml sets dedup_cache_capacity to 512. This recorded configuration is not a live checkout or runtime inspection.

Synthetic PrismBridge design decision: class FrameLatchCache in src/vision/frame_latch.py owns frame de-duplication through method should_emit. It compares frame sequence IDs, not image pixels, to suppress repeated deliveries without suppressing distinct identical-looking frames. Experiment D42 and the recorded streaming configuration support this decision.

Synthetic CopperBridge project, not PrismBridge: class FrameLatchCache and method should_emit in lib/camera/latch.py compare pixel hashes. CopperBridge has a cache capacity of 128. The same symbol names do not make this PrismBridge's implementation.

In this earlier PrismBridge session I decided to measure USB frame latency with a monotonic clock, not the laptop wall clock, because NTP can jump the wall clock backward. The diagnostic experiment label was violet-bridge-27. I have not said that the change was implemented or tested yet.
User-reported PrismBridge controller serial connection: COM4. This report does not establish the live connection; there is no stated supersession of another report.
User-reported PrismBridge controller serial connection: COM7. This report does not establish the live connection; there is no stated supersession of another report.
Synthetic reserve pump Zircon pressure-limit record: 4 kPa. This is a user report, not a live measurement.
